backupPage.subtitle: Keep the library safe in a Git repository and in step across computers

title.needs_remote: No remote to back up to
title.needs_fix_unrelated_histories: This library and the remote do not belong together
title.needs_fix_detached: The library is not on a branch
title.pending_local: Changes are waiting to be backed up
title.pending_both: Changes here and on another device

body.git_missing: Backup uses Git. Install it, then come back to this page.
body.not_set_up: Connect a private repository below and {{app}} keeps a full history of the library there.
body.needs_remote: The library has a local history but nowhere to send it. Connect a repository below.
body.needs_fix_unrelated_histories: The remote holds a different history than this library, so they cannot be merged. Use the remote backup to line them up again.
body.needs_fix_detached: The library is checked out at a fixed point instead of a branch, so nothing can be backed up. Use the remote backup to get back on track.
body.failed: Something went wrong during the last backup.
body.pending_local_one: {{count}} skill changed on this machine since the last backup.
body.pending_local_other: {{count}} skills changed on this machine since the last backup.
body.pending_remote_one: The remote has {{count}} backup this machine has not seen. Sync to bring it into this library.
body.pending_remote_other: The remote has {{count}} backups this machine has not seen. Sync to bring them into this library.
body.pending_both_one: This machine has changes to send and the remote has {{count}} backup to bring in. Sync merges them skill by skill.
body.pending_both_other: This machine has changes to send and the remote has {{count}} backups to bring in. Sync merges them skill by skill.
body.up_to_date: The library and the remote hold the same content.

sync.merged_one: Backup finished. Merged {{count}} update from another device
sync.merged_other: Backup finished. Merged {{count}} updates from another device
sync.conflicts_one: {{count}} skill changed on two devices. Your version was kept. Review it under “Needs attention”
sync.conflicts_other: {{count}} skills changed on two devices. Your versions were kept. Review them under “Needs attention”

toast.disconnected: This machine is disconnected from the backup
toast.recloned: The library now follows the remote backup

conflicts.title: Needs attention
conflicts.description_one: {{count}} skill was changed here and on another device. Pick the version to keep.
conflicts.description_other: {{count}} skills were changed here and on another device. Pick the version to keep for each.

hint.keep_local: Keep the version on this machine and drop the other one
hint.use_remote: Replace the version on this machine with the one from the other device
hint.keep_both: Keep this version and add the other one as a separate skill

conflicts.useRemoteBody: The version on this machine is replaced. A safety snapshot is taken first, so you can go back from the history.

github.title: Connect with GitHub
github.description: {{app}} finds or creates a private repository in your account and backs the library up to it.
github.reconnectDescription: GitHub refused the stored access. Sign in again or paste a new token; the repository stays the same.
github.repoNameHint: Created as a private repository when it does not exist yet.
github.repoNameInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only, up to 100 characters.
github.enterCode: Enter this code on the GitHub page that just opened
github.waiting: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub
github.codeExpired: That code expired before it was approved.
github.tokenHint: Needs the “repo” scope. It goes straight to the system keychain and is never shown again.
github.signInUnavailable: Sign in with GitHub appears here once an OAuth client id is set.
github.publicRepoBody: Anyone can read the skills you back up to it. Make it private in the repository settings on GitHub unless that is what you want.

remote.title: Advanced: any Git URL
remote.description: Back up to any Git remote you can push to: another provider, a self-hosted server, SSH.
remote.credentialsHint: A user name or token typed into the URL is moved to the system keychain and removed from the saved address.

setup.title: How should this machine start?
setup.description: The library is not backed up yet. Choose what to do with

restore.title: Use existing remote backup
restore.body: Download the backup into this library. Skills that only exist on this machine are kept.

new.title: Back up this machine as new
new.body: Start a history from this library and push it to the remote. Best for an empty repository.

recovery.title: Fix the sync setup
recovery.genericReason: This library and the remote backup no longer line up.
recovery.pointRemote: The library is downloaded again from the remote, so both share one history.
recovery.pointLocalOnly: Skills that only exist on this machine are copied back in afterwards.
recovery.pointOldFolder: The current library folder is kept next to the new one, so nothing is thrown away.
recovery.noRemote: There is no remote to download from. Connect a repository first.

history.title: History
history.restoreBody: The library switches to this snapshot as a new backup on top of the history, so nothing is lost. A safety snapshot of the current state is taken first.
history.emptyBody: Every manual backup leaves a snapshot here that you can return to.
history.notSetUpTitle: History starts with the first backup
history.notSetUpBody: Once backup is set up, each backup leaves a snapshot you can restore.

contents.title: What is backed up

included.skills: Every skill folder in the library
included.metadata: Tags and where each skill came from

excluded.credentials: Tokens and passwords (they stay in the system keychain)
excluded.settings: App settings and the local database
excluded.deployments: The copies inside agent and project folders

contents.oversizedExcluded_one: {{count}} skill is larger than {{limit}} and is left out of the backup:
contents.oversizedExcluded_other: {{count}} skills are larger than {{limit}} and are left out of the backup:
contents.oversizedTracked_one: {{count}} skill grew past {{limit}} after it was first backed up. It stays in the backup:
contents.oversizedTracked_other: {{count}} skills grew past {{limit}} after they were first backed up. They stay in the backup:
contents.totalLarge: The library is larger than {{limit}}. Some Git hosts refuse repositories of this size.

auto.title: Automatic backup
auto.description: Backs up a couple of minutes after the library stops changing, and once more when the app quits.

machine.title: Disconnect this machine
machine.body: Forgets the remote and its stored access here. The local history and the remote backup stay as they are.
machine.confirmTitle: Disconnect this machine from the backup?
machine.confirmBody: The remote address and its stored credentials are removed from this machine. Nothing is deleted from the library, its history or the remote.

revoke.title: Revoke authorisation
revoke.body: Opens GitHub where you can take back the access, then disconnects this machine.
revoke.confirmBody: GitHub opens in your browser so you can delete the token or revoke the app. This machine is then disconnected. The remote backup itself is not deleted.

remote.title: Delete remote backup
remote.body: {{app}} never deletes the repository itself. This opens its settings on GitHub, where you can.
remote.bodyOther: {{app}} never deletes the repository itself. Delete it on your Git host if you no longer need it.

firstRun.title: Start fresh, or restore from a backup?
firstRun.description: The library is empty. If you backed it up from another computer, paste the repository address to bring everything over.
firstRun.urlHint: Any Git address you can read from. Leave it empty to start with an empty library.

errors.GIT_MISSING: Git is not installed on this computer. Install Git, then try again.
errors.GIT_AUTH: The remote refused the stored credentials. Reconnect, or check that the token can still write to the repository.
errors.NETWORK: The remote could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The remote took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.GIT_REJECTED: The remote has backups this machine has not seen and would not accept the push.
errors.GIT_UNRELATED: The remote holds a different history than this library, so the two cannot be merged.
errors.GIT_NO_UPSTREAM: The library is not linked to a branch on the remote yet. Back up once to create the link.
errors.GIT_NOT_REPO: Backup is not set up for this library yet.
errors.SYNC_CONFLICT: The same files changed on two devices and could not be merged.
errors.GITHUB_TOKEN_INVALID: GitHub did not accept that token. Check that it was copied completely and has not expired.
errors.GITHUB_SCOPE: The token may not create or read that repository. Create one with the “repo” scope.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_EXPIRED: The sign-in code expired. Start again to get a new one.
errors.GITHUB_DEVICE_DENIED: The sign-in was declined on GitHub.
errors.GITHUB_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sign in with GitHub is not set up. Use an access token, or add an OAuth client id in Settings.
errors.CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE: The system keychain is not available, so the access could not be stored safely.

backupPage.newerApp: Another computer backs up with {{app}} {{version}}. Update {{app}} here so both keep reading the backup the same way.
